title: Shrimp and Shrimp Stew
description: A flavorful and hearty stew made with succulent shrimp and savory aromatics. This dish is perfect for a chilly evening or a special occasion.
instructions: Heat the umami broth over medium heat in a large pot.
Add the chopped onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add the store-bought or homemade stew and stir to combine.
Add the peeled and deveined shrimp and cook for 2-3 minutes, until they start to turn pink.
Add the tomato paste and white wine (if using) and stir to combine.
Bring the stew to a simmer and cook for 5-7 minutes, until the shrimp are cooked through.
Stir in the chopped parsley and season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve the stew hot, garnished with additional parsley if desired.
